about: Race a hover car around 2 tracks with 3 modes: normal race where you have to come first in 2 laps, royale where you win when you reach first place against a large number of cars and bomb where you race around 1 lap dodging balls which are dropped by a large hovercar which stays in the lead at all times.
4 people can play all the above modes against each other in local split screen multiplayer.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
